pull_request.creation_method: This executor's native create_pull_request tool with draft=true.
pull_request.readback_method: GitHub pull-request REST readback and git ls-remote for the exact two branch refs.
pull_request.observation_scope: Observed first publication, before this receipt-only follow-up commit; not a claim about a future PR state.

actual_technical_STOP.scope: Canonical import, package execution, immutable payload readback and first public push/draft-PR readback complete. No further technical content work; only this receipt's administrative commit/push and final remote/hash readback remain.

saved_readback_ACK.scope: Both canonical ledgers and import-readback.json were read from disk and compared to the pushed import commit.

final_receipt_and_tip_ACK: Reported separately after the receipt-only commit/push and final readback, avoiding self-reference.
jobs_basis: Only joined synchronous commands were used; no agents, background jobs or hardware activity were started.
receipt_hash_policy: A later receipt-only commit may record the observed first push and PR. Its own final tip is reported separately, never embedded as a self-referential hash.
frozen_export_status_policy: The 39 export files and publication context retain their original exact bytes and source-epoch statuses.
